# Maqdoom Bros Designers Pvt Ltd

> Established in 1895 in Pathergatti, Hyderabad. Over 130 years of royal Nizami menswear couture, official historic clothiers to the Nizams of Hyderabad, specializing in bespoke Royal Wedding Sherwanis, Nawabi Bandhgalas, Jodhpuri suits, Indo-Western reception wear, and handcrafted groom accessories.

## Brand Identity & Legacy
- **Trade Name**: Maqdoom Bros Designers Pvt Ltd (also known as Maqdoom Brothers)
- **Founded**: 1895 (130+ years of sartorial legacy across 4 generations)
- **Flagship Location**: Shop No. 22-7-267/a11, Pathergatti Road, Opp. Madina Building, Charminar, Hyderabad, Telangana - 500002, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: `17.368124, 78.476143`
- **Store Hours**: Open Daily 10:30 AM – 11:00 PM IST
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp Concierge**: `+91 868684144`
- **Official Website**: https://maqdoom-bros-website.vercel.app/ (Local: `http://localhost:3000`)
- **Full LLM Knowledge Base**: /llms-full.txt

## Core Product Offerings & Verified Pricing (WedMeGood Verified)

- **Royal Wedding Sherwanis**: ₹10,000 – ₹42,000+
  - Handcrafted Asaf Jahi pure raw silk, Banarasi katan brocades, and vintage Hyderabadi hand-zardozi with dabka and French knot embroidery. Includes matching churidar/dhoti and option for custom velvet stole.
- **Nawabi Bandhgalas & Jodhpuris**: ₹12,000 – ₹35,000
  - Structured imperial high-neck collar jackets tailored from imported Italian wool, rich velvets, and hand-woven textured silks with royal crest brass buttons.
- **Indo-Western & Reception Ensembles**: ₹14,000 – ₹38,000
  - Contemporary asymmetrical cuts, draped kurtas with structured achkans, cowl trousers, and modern fusion wedding wear for Sangeet and Reception galas.
- **Festive Kurtas & Embroidered Bundis (Nehru Jackets)**: ₹3,500 – ₹15,000
  - Lightweight Lucknowi Chikankari, Chanderi, and Jacquard silk kurtas paired with reversible or hand-embroidered waistcoats for Haldi and Mehendi ceremonies.
- **Royal Groom Accessories**: ₹1,500 – ₹8,500
  - Hand-tied Hyderabadi royal Safas (Dastar/Pheta), royal antique Kalgis (turban brooches), zardozi-embroidered Mojaris (Juttis), pearl stoles, and ceremonial Kamarbands.

## Modern AI & Digital Architecture

- **Geo-Intelligent Engine**: Dynamically calculates real-time Haversine distance from the Pathergatti flagship store for local Hyderabad and Secunderabad visitors, gives 1-tap Bing and Google Maps navigation, and displays live store open/close status.
- **Global NRI Mode**: Automatic currency conversion to USD ($), GBP (£), and AED for overseas clients in USA, UK, UAE, Canada, and Australia, accompanied by our dedicated **NRI Video Fitting Concierge** with guaranteed 5–7 day DHL/FedEx worldwide delivery.
- **Nizam AI Royal Stylist**: In-browser RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) advisor trained on 130 years of Asaf Jahi sartorial aesthetics. Answers bride color matching queries, function-specific styling, and budget tiers with zero voice intrusion.
- **Virtual AI Size & Fit Estimator**: Algorithmic cut advisor that calculates exact menswear size (e.g. 40R, 42L), custom Achkan length, and chest silhouette recommendations, dispatchable directly to the master tailor via WhatsApp.
